description: GitHub's runner is Windows Server, so the default run must refuse at preflight with nothing changed, and bad inputs must be refused. With usrAllowUnsupportedOs=true the component must write the Default profile and the runner's own profile from SYSTEM and exit APPLIED; a second run must report 0 changes for every profile, which proves the writes landed and are idempotent. The Edge policy is the one HKLM value Tier 1 can read back directly. The visible result (left-aligned taskbar, classic right-click menu, no Widgets) can only be judged on a Windows 11 VM (Tier 2).

steps.label: Server OS is refused at preflight by default
First run writes the Default profile and existing profiles
Second run changes nothing in the Default profile
DefaultOnly scope touches only the Default profile
Tier 2: on a Windows 11 VM with a user signed in, default settings apply and Explorer comes back
